items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I was so -- so astounded because I never heard a guitar played like that before.

ctx.x: Took me a long time to figure him out. Cause things he was playing, just too fast for me to understand. At that time, but later on I began to dig him, what he was doing.
Uh-huh. Now what about, speaking of musicians who played differently, what about Charlie Christian when you first heard him?
Well he was -- he was -- I was so -- so astounded because I never heard a guitar played like that before.
